verdict.rationale: OpenAI Agents SDK is an agent-building framework whose role is to act as an MCP client—docs describe it understanding multiple MCP transports and connecting to existing/self-built MCP servers, not exposing itself as an official MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the agent-role exception, this server-side axis is out of scope unless the SDK itself ships an MCP server mode, which no evidence here shows.
